description: This file provides utility functions for applying and toggling Markdown formatting (bold, italic, link, strike, code, heading, quote, unordered and ordered lists) within a text message, including handling of selection ranges and markdown delimiters.

methods.name: applyMarkdown
methods.description: Main function to apply or toggle specific Markdown styles based on the provided options.

methods.name: applyMarkdownToSelectedLines
methods.description: Applies or toggles Markdown formatting to entire lines based on a delimiter.

methods.name: applyLinkMarkdown
methods.description: Wraps selected text with Markdown link syntax or removes it if already present.

methods.name: applyCodeMarkdown
methods.description: Wraps selected text with inline or block code delimiters depending on multiline selection.

methods.name: applyBoldMarkdown
methods.description: Applies or removes bold Markdown formatting.

methods.name: applyItalicMarkdown
methods.description: Applies or removes italic Markdown formatting.

methods.name: applyBoldItalicMarkdown
methods.description: Handles toggling of bold and italic Markdown styles.

methods.name: getMultilineSuffix
methods.description: Extracts suffix for multiline Markdown formatting.

methods.name: getNewSuffix
methods.description: Extracts suffix for multiline Markdown formatting.
